mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently a comfortable 78 degrees with clear skies near the Verona Public Library. Tonight features a beautiful First Quarter moon, and if you look up at 10:21 PM, you will see a great five-minute pass of the Space Station coming from the Northwest.

The City of Verona has shared details on home composting, encouraging residents to drop off food waste at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop to divert waste from landfills. Additionally, VHAT, Verona's public access cable channel, continues to broadcast local government meetings and community updates on Spectrum and YouTube.

There is a wonderful lineup of events starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by Tuesday trivia nights at Hop Haus and Lake Louie, and the highly anticipated Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park this Wednesday, July 22nd.
In the weekly police recap, officers responded to a call on Monday, July 13th, where a driver was arrested for operating while intoxicated after getting his vehicle stuck on a large rock.

Today's featured flavor at Culver's is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch, and they are open until 10 PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to head over. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor is Chocolate Caramel Twist.
